snippet.title: Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Now live on Kickstarter! Support the game today!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/schoolnightseance/school-night-seance

Demo out now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3991650/School_Night_Seance/
----
School Night Séance is a modern take on the point and click adventure genre. A pair of best friends; the impulsive Melony, and the practical Letty, find themselves separated in a haunted mansion after performing an ill-advised séance. The girls will need to work together to solve puzzles, uncover the mansion’s mysterious history, and finally, reunite and escape the house!

Follow us on Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/schoolnightseance.bsky.social
